   - Adjacent to existing hits (most likely to continue a ship)
   - In high-probability regions (based on remaining ship sizes and board constraints)

This strategy outperforms pure random or simple hunt-and-target approaches by combining efficient coverage with intelligent targeting, minimizing the number of moves required to sink all ships.
